children: Crypto Co entered into amendments to its secured promissory notes on September 21 and 24, 2026, with Eksa Holdings, Practivist Investors, Robert Nail, and Three Mile Creek Future to extend maturities to August 2027. In exchange, the company issued 234,251,400 common shares, equal to 20% of the $1,054,071 aggregate principal, using a reference price of $0.0009 per share. Holders may receive a one-time additional payment equal to 10% of principal outstanding as of May 11, 2027, payable in shares. The amendments aim to extend maturities and preserve liquidity.
